condition: Owner approval of ODR-003 was conditional on the P0 security and integrity corrections passing

local_verification.mypy: 682 source files clean (Windows); test module clean with --platform linux
local_verification.dashboard: typecheck clean, 58 node tests passed, build ok

p0_checks.requirement: 2.1 exact ODR-003 identity, capability, ratifier, ISO date, ODR-001 dependency, schemas and files; recheck at the write boundary; revocation stops writes
2.2 one confirmed request for both files, both revisions checked, staging, backups, journal, deterministic rollback, recovery before any later write or report
2.3 report built in a generation directory, view hash verified, provenance and input revisions recorded, previous report kept on failure
2.4 link and junction refusal, backup retention, codes and locations only in responses
2.5 request security: Host, Origin, token, method, content type, size, field allowlist, CORS, rate limits

accepted_residual_risks: Two file replacements are not one atomic operation; the journal restores or blocks a partial pair
A directory swapped for a link between the check and the replacement needs local write access to the Owner profile
Windows ACLs are inherited from the user profile and not changed by ACASH
File-level symlink refusal is exercised on Linux CI; this Windows host lacks symlink privilege and tests directory junctions instead
